value.quote: A set of submitted preferences Π̄ forms a pure strategy Nash equilibrium
value.note: The minimally dishonest Nash equilibrium is a refinement of NE, so it is covered by NE. DOM: strategy-proofness results such as Theorem 4.3 and Definition 3.3.

C8.1.reason: The minimally dishonest refinement is still a Nash equilibrium concept, so NE covers it and a separate OTH code is not needed.

value.quote: If a point's cost has an intrinsic correspondence to its quality
value.note: Stated: the relation between inputs and held attitudes, strategic minimally dishonest behaviour, and the cost-quality link (conditionally). Unstated: the information assumption needed for agents to reach Nash play, i.e. that they know others' submissions; only the mechanism is stated as common knowledge.

C9.2.reason: The claims about real manipulation and rule assessment rely on agents reaching Nash equilibria, which needs an information assumption that the paper never states.
